OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER

APO 500
16 September 1945
MEMORANDUM TO THE JAPANESE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Yokohama.
SUBJECT : Evacuation of Demobilized Units from Oshima, Niijima and MIyakejima.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum No S-139, Yokohama Liaison Commission, subject as above, dated 14 September 1945.
2. Evacuation of demobilized units from Oshima, Niijima and Miyakejima utilizing vessels under 100 tons is authorized.
3. a. Those vessels will keep clear of areas designated by the U.S. Naval authorities as restricted or operating areas.
b. Those vessels must obey instructions and orders received from U.S. or Allied Naval authorities.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/Harold Fair
/t/HAROLD FAIR
Lt. Colonel AGD.,
Asst Adjutant General.
